purpose: Define and verify a reversible read-only mapping from grandMA3 task regions to Avolites Titan vocabulary without claiming live UI equivalence.

entities.role: MA Lighting official grandMA3 onPC 2.4.2.2 download verified outside repository
Avolites Titan official manual and current support documentation

activities.label: validate five canonical lighting tasks and forward/inverse normalized regions
reject overlap, false equivalence, unsafe capability and incomplete task coverage

queries.expression: does the declarative adapter cover exactly five canonical lighting tasks
does every preview point return to its source region within tolerance
does the contract avoid claiming live UI observation or external execution

assumptions: Normalized rectangular regions are a declarative fixture, not observations of grandMA3 or Titan.
Task-level correspondence is weaker than object-level equivalence.
The renderer must keep execution blocked until a future explicit capability gate passes.
The official grandMA3 download is stored outside the repository and is not a runtime dependency.
kill_tests: A compatible or partial mapping must have a target term.
Unknown or unsupported mappings cannot carry positive confidence.
The contract must include read_only and execute_blocked capabilities.
A target vocabulary other than Avolites Titan is rejected.
Missing one of the five canonical tasks is rejected.
The fixture cannot claim observed surfaces, network use, input injection or source writes.
unknowns: Whether grandMA3 onPC exposes stable UIA roles and rectangles for these regions.
Whether Titan Simulator exposes comparable UIA roles and rectangles.
Whether the declarative map remains stable across layouts and showfiles.
Whether a human operator benefits from the transformed representation.
